changes.description: Fixed the API Gateway `EndpointConfiguration` OpenAPI mapper to write the endpoint configuration extension to the correct location in the generated OpenAPI document.

Fixed the API Gateway `@apiKeyRequired` OpenAPI mapper to combine `api_key` with an operation's inherited or existing security requirements instead of replacing them, so authentication is no longer dropped when an API key is required.
Fixed node validation rejecting null values for timestamp members in a nullable context
Fixed AbstractCodeWriter state interception when interceptors push and pop writer states.
